verdict.rationale: Meltano documents its own scheduled pipelines, orchestrated via Apache Airflow, and manual runs through `meltano run`. So scheduling and manual triggers are covered at a basic level. The pack never shows per-pipeline frequency control, cron syntax, or sub-hour intervals, so only the core is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented cron-expression schedules, sub-hour interval support, per-pipeline frequency configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I control sync frequency per pipeline — from sub-hour schedules to cron expressions and manual triggers

citations.quote: Meltano supports scheduled pipelines that can be orchestrated using Apache Airflow.
You can run EL(T) pipelines using [`meltano run`]
